# OpenClaw

Self-hosted gateway that connects Discord, Google Chat, iMessage, Matrix, Microsoft Teams, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Zalo, and more to AI coding agents. Run one Gateway process on your own machine and message your AI assistant from anywhere.

> Use this file as a lightweight map of the OpenClaw documentation. Fetch individual pages as Markdown with `.md` URLs or `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Agent Resources

- [Markdown page export](https://docs.openclaw.ai/start/getting-started.md): Append `.md` to any docs page URL for clean Markdown.
- [Sitemap](https://docs.openclaw.ai/sitemap.xml): Search crawler URL index.
- [Robots policy](https://docs.openclaw.ai/robots.txt): Bot and crawler policy.

## Documentation Index

- [Agent runtime architecture](https://docs.openclaw.ai/agent-runtime-architecture): How OpenClaw structures the built-in agent runtime: code layout, boundaries, resource manifests, and runtime selection.
- [BlueBubbles removal and the imsg iMessage path](https://docs.openclaw.ai/announcements/bluebubbles-imessage): BlueBubbles support was removed from OpenClaw. Use the official iMessage plugin with imsg for new and migrated iMessage setups.
- [Writer admission authority](https://docs.openclaw.ai/architecture/writer-admission-authority): Proposed transferable authority contracts for SQLite writer admission
- [Auth credential semantics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/auth-credential-semantics): Credential eligibility and resolution rules for auth profiles
- [Automation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation): Overview of automation mechanisms: automations, hooks, standing orders, and workflows
- [Automations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs): Automations: scheduled jobs, webhooks, and Gmail PubSub triggers for the Gateway scheduler
- [Automation delivery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/delivery): Announce, webhook, and none delivery modes, failure alerts, and output language
- [Gmail PubSub triggers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/gmail): Wire Gmail inbox events into OpenClaw through Google Pub/Sub and a restricted reader
- [How automations work](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/how-it-works): Automation runtime model, run lifecycle, and promoting a repeated job into a schedule
- [Manage automations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/managing-jobs): CLI examples, job management commands, run history, and cron configuration keys
- [Automation payloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads): Payload kinds, agent-turn flags, command and script payloads, and session execution styles
- [Automation schedules](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/schedules): Schedule kinds, cron expressions, stream sources, pacing, and condition triggers
- [Automation troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/troubleshooting): Command ladder and fixes for jobs that do not fire or do not deliver
- [Inbound webhooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/webhooks): Gateway HTTP hooks that let an external service wake an agent or submit a turn
- [Hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/hooks): Internal hooks: install, write, and verify automation for commands and lifecycle events
- [Bundled hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/hooks/bundled-hooks): The hooks shipped with OpenClaw and the behavior and options of each
- [Hook configuration and discovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/hooks/configuration): Selecting and enabling internal hooks, and how the Gateway discovers them across sources
- [Hook event types and context](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/hooks/event-types): Every internal event key, its trigger and wait behavior, and the context each producer supplies
- [Hook troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/hooks/troubleshooting): Diagnose a hook that is not discovered, not eligible, or not executing
- [Writing hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/hooks/writing-hooks): Hook directory layout, the handler contract, reply delivery, and the HOOK.md metadata fields
- [IMAP email trigger](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/imap): Watch an IMAP mailbox and route authenticated incoming email to an isolated restricted reader agent
- [MCP Events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/mcp-events): Subscribe to MCP events and run existing Automations from signed webhooks

- [Google Meet plugin](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/google-meet): Google Meet plugin: join explicit Meet URLs through Chrome or Twilio with agent talk-back defaults

- [Message and delivery hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/messages): Claim inbound messages and rewrite or cancel outbound deliveries
- [Prompt and session hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/prompt-and-session): Override the model, shape the prompt, and persist plugin-owned session state
- [Hook reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/reference): How plugin hooks register and execute, plus the complete typed hook catalog
- [Tool call policy hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/tool-policy): Gate, rewrite, and approve tool calls, and rewrite tool results before persistence
- [Plugin install overrides](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/install-overrides): Test packaged plugin overrides with setup-time install flows
